name: Singing
overview: Scripture reveals singing as a powerful expression of praise and trust in God, demonstrated by joyful noise and heartfelt songs celebrating His mercy, power, and salvation. The Psalms emphasize singing as a continual act of worship, encouraging believers to sing of God's wondrous works and to praise Him throughout life. Additionally, singing is linked to the heavenly realm, including angels and the proclamation of new songs, highlighting the eternal and uplifting nature of worship through song.
